data.title: Refer a Friend Ts&Cs
data.content:
TERMS AND CONDITIONS:

These terms and conditions govern your participation in the Pokerbet “Refer a Friend” promotion (the promotion). Your participation in this promotion implies your agreement with these terms and conditions. If you do not agree, you are not permitted to participate.

PRIZE:

Love playing at Pokerbet? Share the fun and get rewarded for it! For every friend you refer who becomes a Successful Referee, you'll earn a R50 Casino Bonus, with no limit on how many friends you can refer. The more friends who join in on the action, the more bonuses you can stack up, provided each referral independently meets the criteria for a Successful Referral set out below.

HOW DOES IT WORK:

1. Referrer Requirements
To be eligible to participate in this promotion and to earn a Casino Bonus, the referrer must, at the time the referee qualifies as a Successful Referee, meet ALL of the following requirements:

  • The referrer's Pokerbet account must be fully verified (FICA verified).
  • The referrer must have made cumulative real money deposits of R100 or more into their Pokerbet account.
  • The referrer must have wagered R100 or more in real money on Casino or Poker. Wagers placed using Bonus funds, Free Spins, or Free Bets do not count towards this requirement.

2. Referee Requirements (“Successful Referee”)
A referee will only be deemed a “Successful Referee”, and the referral a “Successful Referral”, once ALL of the following requirements have been met:

  • The referee must be a new Pokerbet customer who registers using the referrer's unique referral link or referral code.
  • The referee's Pokerbet account must be fully verified (FICA verified).
  • The referee must have deposited a minimum of R100 in real money into their Pokerbet account.
  • The referee must have wagered R100 or more in real money on Casino or Poker. Wagers placed using Bonus funds, Free Spins, or Free Bets do not count towards this requirement

​​​​​​​3. Qualification Period
The referee has seven (7) days from the date of their registration to meet all of the Successful Referee requirements listed above. Should the referee meet these requirements only after the 7-day period has elapsed, the referral will not qualify as a Successful Referral, and no Casino Bonus will be awarded to the referrer in respect of that referee.

4. Bonus Crediting
Once a referee has been confirmed as a Successful Referee, the R50 Casino Bonus will be credited to the referrer's Pokerbet account automatically within 24 hours of confirmation.

The R50 Casino Bonus carries a thirty (30) times (30x) playthrough/wagering requirement, which must be completed on Casino games before any winnings derived from the bonus can be withdrawn.

The R50 Casino Bonus will expire seven (7) days after the date it is credited to the referrer's account, if not used and/or if the wagering requirement has not been met within this period.

The maximum withdrawable winnings generated from each R50 Casino Bonus is capped at R250. Any winnings exceeding this amount will be removed from the referrer's account prior to withdrawal

GENERATING YOUR REFERRAL LINK:

  • A referrer can generate one (1) referral link, with no limit on referrals generated from it.
  • The referral link must be generated in the “Bonuses” section's “Refer a Friend” subsection.
  • You will be able to successfully generate a referral link if the system approves you as a qualified referrer.
  • You can track the progress of your referrals at any time in the “Bonuses” section's “Refer a Friend” subsection.

PLAYTHROUGH CONTRIBUTIONS:

Playthrough contributions vary between games. Below are the games along with their respective contribution rates:

Category

Playthrough Contribution

Slots

100%

Video Poker

50%

SicBo / Baccarat / Craps

2%

Blackjack 

10%

Crash Games / Scratch Cards / Quick Games

5%

Roulette / Game Shows / Betgames

2%

 

PROMOTION SPECIFIC TERMS AND CONDITIONS:

  • This promotion is valid from 1 August 2026 and will run on an ongoing, evergreen basis to eligible Pokerbet customers, unless and until Pokerbet advises otherwise.
  • There is no limit to the number of friends a referrer may refer or the number of Casino Bonuses a referrer may earn under this promotion, subject to each referral independently qualifying as a Successful Referral.
  • A “Friend”/referee must be a genuine new customer who has never previously held a Pokerbet account. Self-referrals, and referrals involving duplicate accounts, shared devices, shared payment methods, or shared household/IP details, will not be considered valid and will not qualify for a Casino Bonus.
  • This promotion is intended for genuine referrals between people who know each other personally. Pokerbet reserves the right to revoke Casino Bonuses and/or exclude customers from future promotions where patterns of abuse are detected, including but not limited to mass/spam referrals or referrals of individuals who meet only the minimum requirements without further genuine play activity.
  • Manual checks will be conducted to confirm that the deposit and wagering requirements for both the referrer and the referee have been met using real money before a Casino Bonus is approved and credited.

GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS:

  1. To participate, your account must pass automatic verification checks. In the event of automatic verification failure, Pokerbet will request FICA documents. Participation in the promotion will be permitted only after the customer's FICA documentation has been verified.
  2. This offer is only for individuals 18 or older who are South African citizens or permanent residents.
  3. Where the Promoters suspect you're cheating or acting fraudulently, we reserve the right to 
  • Suspend you from this promotion.
  • Suspend your Pokerbet account and/or
  • Pause the entire promotion while we investigate.
  1. The Promoters monitor for irregular activity and may disqualify participants who violate these terms
  2. We (Pokerbet management) will decide what constitutes cheating, irregular activity, fraud, or bad faith. Our decision is final. 
  3. Pokerbet reserves the right to change, amend, edit, postpone or cancel the promotion, rules, and terms and conditions at any time and without notice.
  4. All Participants participate entirely at their own risk. By reading these Terms and Conditions and participating in the promotion, the Participant gives consent to these risks and hereby indemnifies and holds harmless the Promoters, their directors, employees and agents of any and all liability pertaining to any damage, cost, injuries, and losses of whatever nature sustained as a result of their participation in the Promotion and related events and activities, save where such damage, cost, injuries or losses are sustained as a result of gross negligence or wilful misconduct of any of the Promoters.
  5. The Promoters, their directors, employees, agents and distributors, are not responsible for any misrepresentation (whether written or verbal) in respect of any Reward nor in respect of any warranties or undertakings given by any person other than the Promoters themselves.
  6. By participating, you confirm you have read and understood these terms.
  7. Standard participation requirements and Terms and Conditions apply.

 

DEFINITIONS:

  • POKERBET ACCOUNT: Your registered and verified account consisting of Cash balance, Free Bet balance, and Bonus balance.
  • REFERRER: An existing, fully verified Pokerbet customer who shares their unique referral link or referral code with a Friend in order to invite them to register a Pokerbet account.
  • FRIEND / REFEREE: An individual who does not have, and has never had, a Pokerbet account, and who registers a new Pokerbet account using a referrer's unique referral link or referral code.
  • SUCCESSFUL REFEREE / SUCCESSFUL REFERRAL: A referee who has met all of the Referee Requirements set out under “How Does It Work” above within the 7-day qualification period.
  • ACCUMULATOR BET: An accumulator is a type of bet that comprises 2 or more folds (selections). Bets containing two or three selections are commonly referred to as a double or treble, respectively.
  • FOLD: A “fold" is a sports betting term that denotes the number of selections included in an accumulator bet.
  • FREE BET: Pokerbet from time to time will run various promotions which may offer Free Bets. Any Free Bet that you qualify for will be added to your Free Bet balance, and can be used to place wagers (a Free Bet may be subject to wagering requirements and/or rollover conditions before they will be credited to your Fee Bet balance). Any Free Bet balance must be used in its entirety as a single bet. This single bet can include single selections or multiple selections in one bet.
  • CASH: The cash balance in your Pokerbet Account, available for wagering.
  • BONUS: Pokerbet from time to time will run various promotions which may offer Bonus funds. Bonus funds can be used to place wagers but are subject to wagering requirements and/or rollover conditions before the withdrawal of any winnings.
  • ROLLOVER CONDITION: A rollover refers to a multiplier applied to a deposit amount, which must be wagered before a Bonus or Free Bet can be granted.
  • WAGERING REQUIREMENTS: Wagering requirements, also known as play-through requirements, represent the total amount of bets a customer needs to place to fulfil the conditions for withdrawing a bonus or its winnings. For instance, if a customer receives a R10 bonus with a 10x wagering requirement, they must place R100 worth of bets before being eligible to withdraw the bonus or its winnings.

 

For any clarification or assistance regarding these Terms and Conditions, please contact Customer Support.

data.title: Weekly Rake Back Ts&Cs
data.content:
TERMS AND CONDITIONS:
These terms and conditions govern your participation in the Pokerbet "Weekly Rake Back Programme" (the Programme). Your participation in this promotion implies your agreement with these terms and conditions. If you do not agree, you are not permitted to participate.
 

RAKE BACK PROGRAMME DETAILS:
Get rewarded for your poker play with our Weekly Rake Back Programme! Receive 10% of your total rake paid back into your account every week.
 

Payment Made Every Monday by 15:00 (UTC)


1. Earn 10% rake back on your total rake contribution.
2. Minimum payout: R150 per week.
3. Maximum payout: R10,000 per week.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

1.  Players must have an active, registered Pokerbet account.
2.  Participate in real-money poker games to generate rake.
3.  The system automatically calculates the rake back based on rake contributions from Sunday 00:00 to Saturday 23:59 (UTC).
4.  If a player's weekly rake back amount meets or exceeds R150, the payout will be credited to their Pokerbet account on Monday.
5.  The rake back amount is real money and carries no wagering requirements.


PROMOTION SPECIFIC TERMS AND CONDITIONS:
1.This promotion is available to all registered Pokerbet users who actively participate in real-money poker games.
2.The minimum rake back payout is R150 per week; hence a player must rake a total of R1500 in the aforementioned
3. If a player's rake back amount is below this, no payout will be made.
4.The maximum rake back payout is capped at R10,000 per week.
5.Rake back is calculated automatically based on Pokerbet’s system records.
6.Players must be in good standing and comply with Pokerbet’s responsible gaming policies to qualify.
7.Rake back payouts are credited every Monday to eligible players' Pokerbet accounts.

 

GENERAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS:
1.To qualify for participation in this promotion, the customer's Pokerbet account must successfully pass the automatic verification check at the time of registration. In the event of automatic verification failure, Pokerbet will request FICA documents. Participation in the promotion will be permitted only after the customer's FICA documentation has been verified.

2.The promotion is only open to persons who are natural persons, 18 years or older, and are either a South African citizen or permanently reside within South Africa.

3.Pokerbet reserves the right to modify, suspend, or terminate the Programme at any time without prior notice.

4.Customer Image and Likeness: 

4.1.With the customer's express consent, Pokerbet may use the customer's alias, image, or likeness for promotional purposes related to Pokerbet or its winners.

4.2.Pokerbet will limit the use of the customer's image or likeness to Pokerbet's promotional channels (website, social media, etc.) and other related Pokerbet marketing materials.

4.3.Right to Withdraw Consent. Customers have the right to withdraw their consent at any time by simply contacting Pokerbet support.

5.Where the Promoters suspect that a winning player is guilty of fraudulent activity, the Promoters reserves the right to suspend or remove that customer from the promotion, and/or suspend that customer's Pokerbet Account and/or suspend the Promotion pending further investigation.

6.Suspected cheating, irregular play, fraudulent activity, and/or bad faith will be determined by Pokerbet's management. Their decision is considered final and binding. Your participation in this promotion implies agreement with this term.

7.The Promoters will continuously monitor for any irregular behaviour, whether it be in entries, betting behaviour and/or participant’s details. Consequently, any violation or attempt and/or suspicion of violation or irregular behaviour and/or non-compliance with these Terms and Conditions will result in immediate disqualification of the Participant. Pokerbet’s decision is final and binding.

8.By virtue of their participation in the promotion every Pokerbet customer shall be deemed to have been given an appropriate opportunity to first read these Terms and Conditions and that they understands and accept these Terms and Conditions.

9.Pokerbet reserves the right to change, amend, edit, postpone or cancel the promotion, rules, prizes, and terms and conditions at any time and without notice.

10.All Participants participate entirely at their own risk. By reading these Terms and Conditions and participating in the promotion, the Participant gives consent to these risks and hereby indemnifies and holds harmless the Promoters, their directors, employees and agents of any and all liability pertaining to any damage, cost, injuries, and losses of whatever nature sustained as a result of their participation in the Promotion and related events and activities, save where such damage, cost, injuries or losses are sustained as a result of gross negligence or wilful misconduct of any of the Promoters.

11.The Promoters, their directors, employees, agents and distributors, are not responsible for any misrepresentation (whether written or verbal) in respect of any Reward nor in respect of any warranties or undertakings given by any person other than the Promoters themselves. Should you require any clarification or advice regarding these Terms, please contact Customer Support.

12.Prizes are not transferable. The prize will not be handed/awarded to a third party, but only to the verified prize winner.

13.Standard participation requirements and Terms and Conditions apply.

 

For further information or assistance regarding these Terms & Conditions, please contact Pokerbet’s Customer Support.

data.title: Seeking Sponsorship?
data.content:
At Pokerbet, we're not just providing you with a premier online Poker and Sports Betting experience but also supporting our community and the vibrant South African sports scene.

If you're looking for sponsorship, we're all ears. Here's what we're after:
 

1.

Introduction: Let us know who you are and why you seek sponsorship.

2.

Background: Share insights into your organisation, event, or project, including past successes.

3.

Objectives: Tell us what you hope to achieve with sponsorship and how it benefits both of us.

4.

Audience/Reach: Paint a picture of your audience and the exposure you offer to potential sponsors.

5.

Sponsorship Opportunities: Give us the lowdown on available packages and what's in it for us.

6.

Marketing and Promotion: How will you shout /about us? Tell us your strategies.

7.

Budget and Investment: Lay out the financial nitty-gritty, including what you need and where it goes.

Ready to make your pitch? Email sponsorship@pokerbet.co.za. If you don't hear back from us in 14 days, consider your application unsuccessful.


We’re eagerly waiting to hear from you and discuss how we can work together to elevate the South African sports and poker scenes.
